rulings.why: The page cannot tell these changes from the row: join:refrain.1.1: Refrain system 1's row: the word that opens the database's line 2, Jesus, is a name of God printed with a capital anyway, after a comma in the same row. The header prints 8.7.8.7.Ref., no metre for the refrain. join:refrain.1.2: Refrain system 2's row (p255-strip1600.jpg): its first word, Fill, follows the full stop that ends system 1's row, so its capital stands anyway. The header gives the refrain no metre that fixes its lines. split:refrain.1.3: Refrain system 2's row: the word that would open the new line, Thy, is a pronoun of God printed with a capital anyway, after a word with no mark. The header's 8.7.8.7 holds the stanzas only and gives the refrain no metre.
